summary: First full run. Backend: 25/25 pytest pass (auth, cities, products, orders+email via Resend sink, admin settings/users/orders, 503 without recipient, disabled-user 403, self-protection). Frontend (390x844 web preview): login (+error), register (validation, bottom-sheet city picker), shop grid (595 items, category chips, search), product detail (color/size pills, size-required error, qty stepper, add-to-cart toast), cart (badge, qty change, remove, empty state), checkout with comment -> success screen with order number, orders tab expandable card, no-recipient checkout error, logout; admin: profile admin rows, settings save/invalid email, cities add/edit/delete, customers search, user edit + disable (SPÄRRAD badge, disabled login message) + delete confirm/cancel, self row protections, all orders. All flows worked. One real backend bug found: order comments containing credential-like phrases (e.g. 'CVV') cause unhandled ValueError in emailer -> 500, order left 'pending'. No deprecated Expo packages found.

critical.issue: emailer._assert_safe_email raises ValueError when the user-supplied comment (or product name) contains any _CRED_ASK phrase (e.g. comment 'Märk med CVV-nummer'). create_order only catches HTTPException, so the request returns 500 Internal Server Error, the order is persisted with email_status='pending' and no email is sent. Customer sees a generic error and will likely retry -> duplicate pending orders. Reproduced via /tmp/cvv.py.

minor.issue: order_number derived from count_documents({}) – not atomic (concurrent orders can get the same number) and no unique index. Use an atomic counter (find_one_and_update $inc).
size is not validated against the product's sizes and unknown color_code is silently dropped (color_name None).
city_id is optional server-side; only the frontend enforces city selection when cities exist.
Rename has no duplicate-name check (POST does, 409). DELETE returns ok even for unknown id.

ui_bugs.issue: Field validation errors stay visible after the user fixes the field (only re-evaluated on submit). Server 422 (e.g. admin@blaklader.local / .local email) shows generic 'Kontrollera att alla fält är korrekt ifyllda.' with no field hint.

integration_issues.issue: Comment containing e.g. 'CVV' -> backend 500, order saved as pending (see backend critical).

issues: Toast is positioned at top and covers the screen header/back button and title for 3.2s (pointerEvents none so taps still work, but header is visually hidden). Consider bottom placement above tab bar/CTA.
Switch thumb renders teal/green on web when ON (RN-web default activeThumbColor) – set activeThumbColor / thumbColor for web to match brand.
Web focus outline draws a white rectangle inside the rounded search field (add outlineStyle: 'none' on web).
When scrolled, product title scrolls under the floating back/cart buttons with no header background (text overlaps buttons).

action_items: HIGH: In create_order, catch ValueError (and generic Exception) from send_email -> mark order 'failed' and return a meaningful 4xx/502; better: don't run credential-phrase scanning on user-entered comment text, or sanitize it (the comment is escaped already).
Use atomic counter for order_number and add unique index on orders.order_number.
Validate size (and color_code) against product data in POST /api/orders.
Clear per-field register errors on change; map 422 detail to field messages.
Move toast so it does not cover headers; fix web Switch thumb color and search input focus outline.
critical_code_review_comments: emailer.send_email raises bare ValueError from _assert_safe_email before the try block – not converted to HTTPException.
count-based order numbering + deleting orders could produce duplicates.
Catalog sync (/api/admin/catalog/sync) only verified for 403 on non-admin; not triggered per instructions.

success_rate.backend: 96% (25/25 tests pass; 1 bug found via extra edge-case)

seed_data_creation: Test users/orders/cities (TEST_/test_ prefixed) were created and cleaned up. Only the admin's B10001 order remains. Recipient restored to delivered@resend.dev.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: export $(grep EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env) && pytest /app/backend/tests/test_blaklader_api.py. Frontend env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Tab testIDs: tab-shop, tab-cart, tab-orders, tab-profile. Stack screens stay mounted on web -> duplicate header-back-button; use ':visible'. Test 503 by unsetting settings.order_email in Mongo and restoring afterwards.
rca_of_issue: POST /api/orders with comment 'Märk med CVV-nummer' -> order_email_html includes comment -> send_email -> _assert_safe_email finds 'cvv' in lowercase body -> ValueError (outside try) -> propagates past `except HTTPException` in create_order -> FastAPI 500. Order already inserted with email_status 'pending'. Mitigation: wrap call with except (ValueError, Exception) -> set failed + return 4xx/502, or exclude user comment from the phrase scan.
